on create.

schedule_agent.description: Who sends scheduling messages to the attendee.

EventData.description:
The canonical event model. Every field is optional: on create the application supplies the missing required
ones (UID, start). A write is merged into the stored event like a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) for the members of
the event: a field with a value replaces the stored one, a field that is absent keeps it, and a field that is
`null` removes it. The rule goes no deeper than the members: an object or a list that is sent (`recurrence`,
`organizer`, `start`, `end`, `alarms`, `categories`) replaces the stored one as a whole, and only attendees are
matched, by address.

alarms.description: The alarms; the list replaces the stored alarms, `null` or an empty list removes them all.

attendees.description: The attendees; the list replaces the stored attendees, `null` or an empty list removes them all.

categories.description: The categories; `null` or an empty list removes them.

description.description: The description. `null` removes it, and so does an empty text.

duration.description: The length; mutually exclusive with `end`. `null` removes it.

end.description: The end; mutually exclusive with `duration`. `null` removes it.

location.description: The location. `null` removes it, and so does an empty text.

recurrence.description: The recurrence definition; `null` or an empty `Recurrence` removes it.

recurrence_id.description:
Selects an override instance of a recurring event; absent addresses the master component. `null` is the
same as absent: the instance selector is no field that a write could remove.

sequence.description:
The revision number; the server raises it on significant changes when the client does not. `null` is the
same as absent: the number belongs to the server and is no field that a write could remove.

summary.description: The title. `null` removes it, and so does an empty text.

transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time. `null` removes it.

uid.description: The iCalendar UID; derived from the external key or generated when absent on create. It cannot be `null`.

url.description: A link related to the event. `null` removes it.

An iCalendar duration (`DURATION`, RFC 5545 section 3.3.6) such as `PT30M`, `P1D`, `P1W` or `-PT15M`,
normalized to upper case.

sent_by.description: Set when someone acts on behalf of the organizer (`SENT-BY`).

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone of a local `date_time`.

ExternalKey.description: The caller-chosen stable key of an object, used by the management API (`[A-Za-z0-9._:~-]{1,200}`).

ScheduleAgent.description: Who performs scheduling for an attendee (`SCHEDULE-AGENT`, RFC 6638).

oneOf.description: `SERVER` (the default): the server delivers scheduling messages.
`CLIENT`: the client takes care of it; the server never delivers.

TimeZoneName.description:
An IANA time zone name (`Europe/Berlin`, `UTC`), validated against the bundled time zone database.

Names are case-sensitive as in the database. Windows zone names are mapped to IANA names by `davhaven-ical`
before they reach this type.

Uid.description: An iCalendar `UID`: one to 255 bytes without control characters. Unique per calendar.

calendar_id.description: The calendar to create the event in; the principal needs write access.

client_request_id.description:
Makes the call repeatable: the UID is derived from the calendar and this id (`[A-Za-z0-9._:~-]{1,200}`), so a
repeated call returns the existing event instead of creating a second one (`created: false`). An id that

event.description: The event fields; `summary` and `start` are required.

notify_attendees.description:
Whether attendees are invited by mail or calendar delivery (default `false`: the event is stored without
notifying anyone). External attendees additionally need the `mcp:schedule_external` scope.

schedule_agent.description: Who sends scheduling messages to the attendee.

EventData.description:
The canonical event model. Every field is optional: on create the application supplies the missing required
ones (UID, start). A write is merged into the stored event like a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) for the members of
the event: a field with a value replaces the stored one, a field that is absent keeps it, and a field that is
`null` removes it. The rule goes no deeper than the members: an object or a list that is sent (`recurrence`,
`organizer`, `start`, `end`, `alarms`, `categories`) replaces the stored one as a whole, and only attendees are
matched, by address.

alarms.description: The alarms; the list replaces the stored alarms, `null` or an empty list removes them all.

attendees.description: The attendees; the list replaces the stored attendees, `null` or an empty list removes them all.

categories.description: The categories; `null` or an empty list removes them.

description.description: The description. `null` removes it, and so does an empty text.

duration.description: The length; mutually exclusive with `end`. `null` removes it.

end.description: The end; mutually exclusive with `duration`. `null` removes it.

location.description: The location. `null` removes it, and so does an empty text.

recurrence.description: The recurrence definition; `null` or an empty `Recurrence` removes it.

recurrence_id.description:
Selects an override instance of a recurring event; absent addresses the master component. `null` is the
same as absent: the instance selector is no field that a write could remove.

sequence.description:
The revision number; the server raises it on significant changes when the client does not. `null` is the
same as absent: the number belongs to the server and is no field that a write could remove.

summary.description: The title. `null` removes it, and so does an empty text.

transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time. `null` removes it.

uid.description: The iCalendar UID; derived from the external key or generated when absent on create. It cannot be `null`.

url.description: A link related to the event. `null` removes it.

EventDuration.description:
An iCalendar duration (`DURATION`, RFC 5545 section 3.3.6) such as `PT30M`, `P1D`, `P1W` or `-PT15M`,
normalized to upper case.

sent_by.description: Set when someone acts on behalf of the organizer (`SENT-BY`).

EventStatus.description: Status of an event (`STATUS` on a `VEVENT`).

EventTime.description: A point in an event: an all-day date, a floating local time, a local time in a zone, or a UTC instant.

date_time.description: A date and time of day, local or UTC (see the type documentation).

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone of a local `date_time`.

Recurrence.description: The recurrence definition of an event.

RecurrenceRule.description:
A recurrence rule value (RFC 5545 `RECUR`) such as `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE`, normalized to upper case
without a leading `RRULE:`. The syntax and the limits (no `SECONDLY`/`MINUTELY`) are checked by
`davhaven-ical`; this type only guarantees a safe, single-line text with a `FREQ`.

ScheduleAgent.description: Who performs scheduling for an attendee (`SCHEDULE-AGENT`, RFC 6638).

oneOf.description: `SERVER` (the default): the server delivers scheduling messages.
`CLIENT`: the client takes care of it; the server never delivers.

TimeZoneName.description:
An IANA time zone name (`Europe/Berlin`, `UTC`), validated against the bundled time zone database.

Names are case-sensitive as in the database. Windows zone names are mapped to IANA names by `davhaven-ical`
before they reach this type.

Uid.description: An iCalendar `UID`: one to 255 bytes without control characters. Unique per calendar.

calendar_id.description: The calendar of the event; the principal needs write access.

changes.description:
The fields to change, like a JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) of the members of the event: a field with a value
replaces the stored one (a nested object or a list as a whole: `recurrence`, `organizer` and `start` are not
merged member by member, attendees are matched by address), an absent field keeps it and `null` removes it
(`uid` and `start` cannot be removed).

if_match.description: The entity tag the change is based on; a stale tag fails with `precondition-failed`.

notify_attendees.description: Whether attendees are notified of the change (default `false`).

CalendarUserAddress.description:
A normalized calendar user address (`ORGANIZER`, `ATTENDEE`, `calendar-user-address-set`).

* `mailto:` addresses are lowercased; header fields after `?` are dropped.
* `urn:uuid:` addresses carry a lowercase hyphenated UUID (principal ids).
* `http(s)` URLs and path-absolute URLs (principal URLs) are kept as written, with scheme and host
  normalized for absolute URLs.

Equality of two normalized addresses is the case-insensitive address match of PLAN 2.6.

oneOf.description: `PRIVATE`: busy-only for everyone but the owner in feeds and free-busy.

precondition that cannot match.

attendee_count.description: How many attendees the event has.
